purpose: Serving throughput workload selection using saved-response metadata only; not an evaluation result or protocol change.

sample_method.selection: Uniform reservoir sampling of sorted run directories and sorted response filenames in the primary family/results/runs tree. Each task restarts the seed. Filenames enumerated once per task; only selected JSON files opened.
sample_method.content_exclusion: No prompt, sequence, label, reasoning or final-answer content is included in this report or used to choose the synthetic text.
sample_method.quantile_definition: p50 is conventional median; p90 is nearest-rank ceil(0.9*n).
sample_method.caveat: Saved files accumulate during sampling. Samples describe already-saved responses, not all planned cases; per-request elapsed_seconds is not aggregate throughput.

benchmark_guidance: Generate artificial non-biological text independent of evaluation files. Match token counts; do not send saved evaluation content to the benchmark solver.
Use fixed output-token generation with ignore_eos for synthetic throughput measurement and record this difference from evaluation generations.
Record effective concurrency, request count, prompt/completion counts, wall time, request and token throughput, latency, failures, KV cache use and preemption.
Keep model checkpoint, BF16 precision and one TP1 replica identical to production. Changing max_num_seqs for synthetic measurement does not modify evaluation prompts or response budgets.
P16 is a separate long-context B200 workload: about44.8k input tokens and strong shared-prefix caching. A unique random45k prompt on A100 would not model its observed cache behavior.
